title: Settings
savedAccount: Saved to your account, on every device.
savedBrowser: Saved in this browser. Log in to keep them on every device.

look.title: Look
look.text: How the site looks for you.

motionHint.reduce: Only small, quick animations. Nothing loops or bounces.
motionHint.none: No animations at all: every change happens at once.

look.loudSoundsText: Sudden loud sounds, like the explosion when you divide by zero in the dash's calculator. Off: they play silently.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: Our host, Cloudflare, adds anonymous page statistics (Cloudflare Web Analytics) to the site.
analytics.blockText: Nothing about your visits is sent to Cloudflare's statistics. Works from the next page load.

profile.title: Profile & privacy
profile.notMember: Your profile shows once you're in the Discord server; until then nobody else sees it.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.text: What you get told about: on the site (the bell), by email (needs a verified email) and as push notifications on the devices you turn them on for.
notify.moderationText: Warnings and other decisions of the moderators.
notify.fdcText: When an editor answers a cat design you suggested.
notify.birthdaysText: When a birthday celebration moves to another day.
notify.reportsText: Every new member report (you are staff).
notify.pushOn: On. This device gets the kinds below that have Push ticked.
notify.pushOff: Off on this device. Turn it on to get notifications even when the site is closed.
notify.pushEnabled: Push notifications are on for this device.
notify.pushTestSent: Sent. It should show up in a moment.
notify.pushTestNone: No device got it. Turn push on for this device first.
notify.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser's site settings, then try again.

pushReason.server: Push notifications aren't set up on this server yet.
pushReason.browser: This browser can't receive push notifications.
pushReason.install: On iPhone and iPad, add the site to the home screen first (Share → Add to Home Screen), then turn push on there.

login.title: Email & login
login.text: Log in with your email and a password too, protected with a second step. Discord logins don't change.

account.title: Your account
account.text: Profile, privacy, email and deleting your data need a login.

css.title: Custom CSS
css.text: Your own styles for the whole site (and the emails it sends you). Add ?nocss to any address to turn them off for that page.

delete.sectionText: Removes your account and all data about you, immediately.
delete.title: This deletes your account and everything about you, right now.
delete.profile: Your profile, bongo avatar, settings and presets
delete.stats: Your levels, points, pets, taps, birthday and other stats
delete.mentions: The bot's messages that mention you
delete.log: Everything about you in the activity log, except one line saying that you deleted your account
delete.final: It can't be undone. Reports about your account are kept (see <privacy>Privacy</privacy>). You can log in again later, but you start from zero.

tabs.generalText: Look, language, time, buttons, custom CSS
tabs.notificationsText: On the site, by email, as push
tabs.dashText: Your start page: look, layout, pages

chrome.title: Site buttons
chrome.text: The buttons at the top of every page.
chrome.themeSwitchText: The switch in the corner. The theme stays as you set it here.
chrome.languageSwitchText: The language button in the corner.
chrome.hint: Both switches always show here, so you can bring them back.

dashData.title: Your dash data
dashData.text: Everything your dash keeps: its layout and widgets, your integrations, your music library and uploaded files. Nothing of it is used for anything but showing your dash.

points.layout: Pages, widgets and everything in them (notes, to-dos, bookmarks, read releases)
points.files: Uploaded songs, wallpapers, fonts and pictures

dashData.final: Your account stays. Every device starts with the default dash. This can't be undone.

dashTab.text: How your dash looks and works. Changes show on the dash right away and on your other devices a moment later.

searchTab.text: The search bar on your dash: engines, !keywords, the tools that answer as you type, and where website icons come from.

about.title: About HomeSite
about.text: A personal website with a dash, a search and a Discord community's home.
about.credit: Made by <name>MrKoby07</name>. Ideas, bugs, questions: open an issue on GitHub or write on Discord.
about.issues: Report a problem or an idea

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.text: The picture shown with your name on this site. Your Discord picture unless you choose your own.
avatar.hint: Shown on your profile, in the member list and in the account button. Discord itself isn't changed.
avatar.type: That isn't a picture this can use (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF).
avatar.tooBig: That picture is bigger than 12 MB.
avatar.placeHelp: Drag to move it, zoom with the wheel, two fingers or the slider. What's inside the circle is kept.
avatar.animatedHint: Animated pictures keep moving. Drag to move it, zoom with the wheel or the slider.
